topic.label: Human Rights
topic.desc: Human Rights: the law, philosophy, institutions and practice of protecting human dignity, from treaties to monitoring and advocacy.

concepts.label: Institutions and Enforcement Mechanisms
concepts.desc: UN charter and treaty bodies, regional courts and commissions, and national institutions that monitor and enforce rights.

concepts.label: International Human Rights Law
concepts.desc: The treaty and customary framework: the UDHR, the ICCPR and ICESCR, core conventions, state obligations and derogations.

concepts.label: Monitoring, Documentation and Investigation
concepts.desc: Methods for documenting violations: interviews, open-source evidence, chain of custody and reporting standards.

concepts.label: Specific Rights and Groups
concepts.desc: Civil, political, economic, social and cultural rights, and protection of women, children, refugees, minorities and indigenous peoples.

concepts.label: Foundations and Theory of Rights
concepts.desc: Philosophical and historical foundations of human rights: dignity, universality, relativism and the generations of rights.

concepts.label: Transitional Justice and Accountability
concepts.desc: Responses to mass violations: criminal trials, truth commissions, reparations and institutional reform.

skills.label: Jurisprudence Summary
skills.desc: Summarises regional court jurisprudence on a right, checked by citing each case and holding.

skills.label: Complaint Forum Selection
skills.desc: Recommends which court, commission or treaty body can hear a complaint, checked against admissibility rules.

skills.label: Universal Periodic Review Tracker
skills.desc: Tracks recommendations made to a state in the universal periodic review and its responses, checked against the official documents.

skills.label: Limitation and Derogation Test
skills.desc: Tests a restriction for legality, necessity and proportionality, checked by applying each step to the facts.

skills.label: State Obligation Analysis
skills.desc: Analyses a situation under the duties to respect, protect and fulfil, checked by citing the article and general comment used.

skills.label: Treaty Provision Finder
skills.desc: Identifies which treaty articles protect a right and whether a state has ratified them, checked against the official ratification status.

skills.label: Open-Source Evidence Verification
skills.desc: Verifies the date, location and authenticity of images and videos, checked by recording each verification step.

skills.label: Testimony Interview Protocol
skills.desc: Prepares a trauma-informed interview plan with informed consent, checked against documentation ethics standards.

skills.label: Violation Report Drafter
skills.desc: Drafts a monitoring report linking documented incidents to legal standards, checked by tracing every claim to evidence.

skills.label: Advocacy Strategy Plan
skills.desc: Builds an advocacy plan with targets, messages and channels for a rights issue, checked by tying each step to a measurable outcome.

skills.label: Economic and Social Rights Assessment
skills.desc: Assesses progressive realisation of a right using indicators and budgets, checked by recomputing each indicator.

skills.label: Group Protection Analyst
skills.desc: Identifies the instruments protecting a specific group such as refugees or children, checked against the relevant convention text.

skills.label: History of Rights Timeline
skills.desc: Dates key texts and movements in the history of rights, checked against the documents themselves.

skills.label: Rights Justification Analysis
skills.desc: Compares justifications for a right from dignity, natural law and capability theories, checked by citing the theorist for each argument.

skills.label: Universality and Relativism Debate
skills.desc: Lays out universalist and cultural relativist positions on a practice, checked by sourcing each position.

skills.label: Atrocity Crime Elements
skills.desc: Maps facts to the legal elements of genocide, crimes against humanity or war crimes, checked against statute definitions.

skills.label: Accountability Mechanism Comparison
skills.desc: Compares trials, truth commissions and reparations programs for a context, checked by citing precedents for each option.

skills.label: Reparations Program Design
skills.desc: Designs eligibility and benefit forms for a reparations program, checked against international reparations principles.
